description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/Dispatch/Get. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the GET get operation in shipping and dispatch operations. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the get operation for shipping and dispatch operations. Input: Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the get operation. Search terms: dispatch get. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

name: hgr_get_dispatch_get
title: Get Dispatch Get
